## Changes in Dolos local version:
1. Switching remote reference for tx3 and trix, to use local versions instead (`crates/trp/Cargo.toml:27-41`):
```rust
#tx3-lang = "0.11.4"
#tx3-cardano = "0.11.4"
#tx3-resolver = "0.11.4"

tx3-lang = { path = "../../../tx3/crates/tx3-lang" }
tx3-cardano = { path = "../../../tx3/crates/tx3-cardano" }
tx3-resolver = { path = "../../../tx3/crates/tx3-resolver" }

# tx3-lang = { git = "https://github.com/tx3-lang/tx3.git" }
# tx3-cardano = { git = "https://github.com/tx3-lang/tx3.git" }
# tx3-resolver = { git = "https://github.com/tx3-lang/tx3.git" }

#tx3-sdk = { version = "^0" }
 tx3-sdk = { path = "../../../rust-sdk/sdk" }
# tx3-sdk = { git = "https://github.com/tx3-lang/rust-sdk.git" }
```
2. Adding the blockchain tip in dolos compiler (`crates/trp/src/compiler.rs:7,93-109`):
```rust
use tx3_cardano::ChainPoint;
...
pub fn load_compiler<D: Domain>(
    genesis: &Genesis,
    ledger: &D::State,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<tx3_cardano::Compiler, Error> {
    let pparams = build_pparams::<D>(genesis, ledger)?;

    let compiler = tx3_cardano::Compiler::new(
        pparams,
        tx3_cardano::Config {
            extra_fees: config.extra_fees,
        },
        ChainPoint{hash:vec![], slot:0},
    );

    Ok(compiler)
}
```

## Changes in tx3 local version
1. Replacing withdrawal name to withdraw for compiling withdraw redeemers (`tx3-lang/src/cardano.rs:170`):
```rust
Ok(ir::AdHocDirective {
            name: "withdraw".to_string(),
            data: std::collections::HashMap::from([
                ("credential".to_string(), credential),
                ("amount".to_string(), amount),
                ("redeemer".to_string(), redeemer),
            ]),
        })
```
Also replacing withdrawal name to withdraw in `tx3-cardano/src/compile/mod.rs:382`:

```rust
pub fn compile_withdrawals(
    tx: &ir::Tx,
    network: Network,
) -> Result<Option<BTreeMap<primitives::RewardAccount, primitives::Coin>>, Error> {
    let withdrawals: BTreeMap<_, _> = tx
        .adhoc
        .iter()
        .filter(|x| x.name.as_str() == "withdraw")
        .map(|adhoc| compile_withdrawal_directive(adhoc, network))
        .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;

    if withdrawals.is_empty() {
        Ok(None)
    } else {
        Ok(Some(withdrawals))
    }
}
```

## Changes in trix local version
1. Switching to tx3-lang local version (`Cargo.toml:10-12`):
```rust
#tx3-lang = "0.11.0"
tx3-lang = { path = "../tx3/crates/tx3-lang" }
# tx3-lang = { git = "https://github.com/tx3-lang/tx3.git" }
```

2. Adding interpretation for Map type (`src/commands/bindgen.rs:79,93,107`):
```rust
fn get_type_for_language(type_: &tx3_lang::ir::Type, language: &str) -> String {
    match language {
        "rust" => "ArgValue".to_string(),
        "typescript" => match &type_ {
            ...
            tx3_lang::ir::Type::Map => "any".to_string(),
        },
        "python" => match &type_ {
            ...
            tx3_lang::ir::Type::Map => "any".to_string(),
        },
        "go" => match &type_ {
            ...
            tx3_lang::ir::Type::Map => "any".to_string(),
        },
        _ => "ArgValue".to_string(), // Default fallback
    }
}
```
Similar changes also in `src/commands/build.rs:182`:
```rust
impl Display for Tx3Type {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match &self.0 {
            ...
            ir::Type::Map => write!(f, "Map"),
        }
    }
}
```
